proposals.before: His elder brother inherited their father's marquisate; Shi Dan declined any share of the estate.
proposals.after: His elder brother inherited their father's marquisate and declined any share of the estate.
proposals.reason: Chinese 讓不受分 follows 丹兄嗣父爵為侯; the next sentence 丹盡得父財 shows the elder brother yielded the property share, not Shi Dan.

proposals.before: Dan's elder brother inherited their father's marquisate as marquis; Dan yielded and did not accept a share.
proposals.after: Dan's elder brother inherited their father's marquisate as marquis; he yielded and did not accept a share.
proposals.reason: The subject of 讓不受分 is the elder brother who took the title, matching 丹盡得父財 in the next unit.

proposals.before: Fu Xi, courtesy name Zhiyou, came from Wen in Henei commandery. He was the younger brother of Grand Empress Dowager Fu of Dingtao, Emperor Ai's grandmother.
proposals.after: Fu Xi, courtesy name Zhiyou, came from Wen in Henei commandery. He was a paternal cousin of Grand Empress Dowager Fu of Dingtao, Emperor Ai's grandmother.
proposals.reason: 從父弟 means a younger paternal cousin (father's brother's son), not a younger brother.

proposals.before: Fu Xi, courtesy name Zhiyou, was a man of Wen in Henei; he was the younger brother by the same father of Empress Dowager Fu of Dingtao, Emperor Ai's grandmother.
proposals.after: Fu Xi, courtesy name Zhiyou, was a man of Wen in Henei; he was a younger paternal cousin of Empress Dowager Fu of Dingtao, Emperor Ai's grandmother.
proposals.reason: 從父弟 is a collateral paternal cousin, not a same-father younger brother.

decisions.reason: In 丹兄嗣父爵為侯，讓不受分 the continuing subject of 讓不受分 is 丹兄; s0053 丹盡得父財 confirms Shi Dan received the whole estate, so the original attribution of declining the share to Shi Dan is wrong and the proposed repair is accurate.

decisions.reason: 讓不受分 continues the subject 丹兄 from 丹兄嗣父爵為侯; replacing the wrongly inserted subject Dan with he correctly keeps the elder brother as the one who yielded the share, consistent with 丹盡得父財.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 丹兄嗣父爵為侯，讓不受分

decisions.reason: 從父弟 denotes a younger paternal cousin (son of a father's brother), not a uterine younger brother; the proposed idiomatic line correctly repairs that kinship without altering other accurate content.

從父弟 is a collateral paternal cousin, not a same-father younger brother; younger brother by the same father invents agnatic siblingship that the Chinese does not state, and the proposed literal repair restores the correct kinship.
